    Appendix: pay rate insights and overtime

    The program reports on the expanded pre-agreement definition, highlighting opportunities to partner on cost avoidance, rate optimization and overtime spend.

    Rate analysis

    Negotiated: Magnit is notified of a pre-agreement but can still negotiate pay with the candidate. Pre-agreed: CWAM negotiated and finalized pay directly with the CW. MSP alignment: CWx partnership needed to match CW skills to the JD and rates. Pivots: worker moving between roles, usually with a pay rate change.

    Request mix trend, Q1 to Q3 2026

    Count of requests by rate outcome, with negotiated savings rate on the right axis

    Q3 highlights

    • Negotiated fills averaged 6.34% below max bill rate, generating cost avoidance.
    • Pre-agreed increase driven primarily by the KEP project ramp-up, with additional CX growth.
    • Increased support for the NeXt Up Program (5) and Creative (9) drove a rise in pre-agreed requests.

    Q4 focus

    • Review and present Magnit pay rate intelligence as an additional resource to validate Meta's market rates and keep alignment with market benchmarks.
    • Leverage AI to identify above-market rates, uncover negotiation trends, and highlight where CWAM education can support more cost-effective hiring decisions.

    Maggi and Magnit Pulse: what is changing

    Releases from Q2 and Q3 2026 that change how Meta's managers, MSP team and CWs work day to day.

    Magnit Pulse: channel of choice

    Pulse makes it easier for hiring managers to get things done by bringing VMS actions into the tools they already use, such as Microsoft Teams, Slack or client-specific platforms. Today, working in the VMS is intentional: you log in and take action. Pulse flips that model so the VMS comes to the manager, surfacing the right actions and key moments where they already work.

    The goal: extend the VMS, not replace it. Less friction and a shorter gap between awareness and action means faster decisions and a smoother hiring process at Meta's scale.

    Compliance and marketplace updates

    Organizations face rapid AI-driven transformation and shifting economic conditions. Prioritize AI-skilled talent, upskilling and retention while navigating uncertainty with cautious optimism.

    Horizon scanning: global compliance

    Magnit's Operational Compliance team tracks changing international requirements to prepare Meta for upcoming changes and potential impacts.

    EU Pay Transparency progress tracker

    Progress of 27 member states up to end October 2026. The transposition deadline was June 7, 2026.

    What the Directive requires

    • Disclose pay ranges or starting pay to candidates before interview; no pay history questions.
    • Workers can request individual and average pay levels broken down by sex.
    • Report gender pay information and remedy unexplained gaps of 5% or more within six months, or face a joint pay assessment.
    • In equal pay claims, the burden of proof shifts to the employer.
    • Monitor national laws for local variations, such as lower reporting thresholds or additional pay elements.
